title: S020 直排裡的盒子
reproduces: PLAN 1-6e (kusamakura's cover): boxes in vertical-rl that sent the chapter to Legacy. Chapter 1: sizes on the block and inline axes (min-width, max-height, height, percentages). Chapter 2: floats (float: left is the column's top, right its bottom), a picture sized by a percentage height, text flowing beside it. Chapter 3: inline-blocks, of text and around a picture sized to the box.
